results.name: Choose deliberately, preview, edit independent copies and download the exact private-safe plan
Source edits and deletion invalidate confirmation without replacing the open visit
Cancellation preserves unsaved open words and chosen work never writes by itself
Source inspection is read-only, survives a missing source, and excludes private notes
Saved plan returns offline with exact order and communication needs; narrow preview fits
Two appointments through conversation, interruption, answers and remaining work preserve the original
Full browser restart offline preserves the new plan and source inspection
Isolated-browser transfer preserves the plan and a differing returned source maps to its own version
Failed saving keeps the plan available and export works even if storage becomes unreadable
Empty library, closed-item disclosure and blank plans have deliberate paths
Another tab invalidates source choices while preserving the selected preview
Keyboard choices, literal long text, enlarged layout and screenshots retain privacy
Reordering resets the saved starting question and conversation begins with the chosen first question

limits: No physical-device, screen-reader or participant testing.
Clipboard refusal and printing are simulated; browser print content is inspected.
